name: all-clients
description: 4 oldxdc validators + one follower of every OTHER client that can join a custom-chainId network from a genesis file: geth, erigon, besu, reth, xone. nethermind is deliberately excluded -- it only loads its own bundled net5151 Parity-style chainspec, not an arbitrary --genesis file (ItWorksinMyLocal#46 open question #2; nethermind stays a net5151-join-only client until a genesis->chainspec converter exists). The full cross-client bring-up for peer-starvation / matrix-style regression testing.
